scenes.narration: The helper calls stitch_well, checks all four neighboring overlaps, and then calls compose_window. All four tiles are placed. Their patch is two thousand seven hundred fifty-six pixels square. The loop closes within a quarter pixel in this acquisition, not a universal accuracy guarantee.

scenes.narration: Do not trust placement alone. Compare actual overlapping pixels independently of the registration score. Here, aligned correlations are much stronger than correlations after deliberately shifting either axis by seventeen pixels. Those wrong-offset controls help detect a plausible-looking but incorrect placement.
